PDF too big to email? Shrink it 📎

1️⃣ Open pdf.315tools.com
2️⃣ Tap Compress PDF and pick your file
3️⃣ Save the smaller PDF and attach it

Your file is processed in your browser and never leaves your device. No app, no sign-up.
